description: Lists the upcoming matches of one competition over the next days, each with home/draw/away probabilities from the free Dixon-Coles model offered by Docteur Bet, when published. The competition can be given by name ("Premier League", "Ligue 1", "Champions League"), common abbreviation ("EPL", "UCL") or id from list_competitions.

lang.description: Language of the summary and notices: "en" or "fr".

name: get_upcoming_matches
title: Upcoming matches
